objective: Derive the exact leaf forbidden set and submit a vertex- and edge-minimal no-recoloring obstruction, with an explicitly scoped repair.

atomic_claims.text: The forbidden set equals the incident palette union the middle colors of simple three-edge alternating continuations from u.
Six-color saturation forces two degree-three neighbors, four differently colored spokes and their root-color supports.
Every no-recoloring leaf obstruction has at least eight vertices and nine edges; the displayed graph attains both bounds.
The displayed star coloring of G-v cannot be extended with any of the six colors while preserving all old colors.
For the displayed witness, changing xa from 3 to 5 and coloring uv with 3 gives a star six-coloring.

assumptions: Finite simple undirected graphs; maximum degree at most three.
v is a leaf adjacent to u; old coloring is proper and has no bichromatic four-edge path or cycle.
Palette is exactly the available set {1,2,3,4,5,6}; use need not be surjective in general.
Only finite-graph-basic and finite-combinatorics are used.
risks: The local fixed-coloring quantifier is stronger than the root's existence quantifier.
All mathematical derivations and pair tables await external checking; no solver or kernel was run.
The universal one-edge repair is only a proposal for the next falsification cycle.
Acyclicity is not assumed; paths are simple but need not be induced.

failed_route_proposal.blocker: The zero-edit arbitrary-coloring extension has the explicit eight-vertex obstruction. Fingerprint is SHA-256 of the UTF-8 route_id, with no newline.
